definitions.explanation: A long needle used for knitting, usually in pairs. From {編|あ}む (to knit) plus {針|はり} (needle).

examples.japanese: {編|あ}み{針|ばり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧。
examples.english: To knit a scarf with knitting needles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{編|あ}み{針|ばり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought yarn and knitting needles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{編|あ}み{針|ばり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かし→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother told old stories while working her knitting needles.

notes:
From ⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ (to knit) plus ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle); the ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ voices to ば in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{針|ばり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to knit with needles
- {棒針|ぼうばり}: straight knitting needle
- かぎ{針|ばり}: crochet hook

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}→縫い針：28209_nuibari⟧: sewing needle
- ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧: knitting yarn
